open_faults.detail: I reported yesterday that the Analyst 'asserts Watcher readings it never fetched'. That was wrong. src/analyst_agent.py line 335 injects the full verdict into the prompt as 'Watcher latest: {...}', and the _watcher() docstring states the snapshot serves 'context AND read_watcher tool'. The check at line 238 fires whenever the word 'watcher' appears in reasoning without a read_watcher call, which the design makes unnecessary. It has now stamped two consecutive decisions (08-17, 08-18) with a defect that is not one. I also verified the content: the 08-18 claim of '30y yield 5.33%, AI-correction chatter' matches the 2026-08-18T12:29:22Z scan verbatim, and that was the current verdict when the agent ran at 13:37Z. A guardrail that cries wolf on correct behaviour trains the reader to ignore it.
